name: Ashash
description: Ashash was a waterworld located in the Ashash system, a part of the Zarracina sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. It was home to a species of creature that could emit a harmful gas from its body—an aspect in which the creature was similar to the stinkfish of the Outer Rim Territories planet Sedri.
